description: This file defines classes and methods for managing SSH key data and commands within the pykickstart framework, including parsing and string representation of SSH keys for different Red Hat-based systems.

classes.name: F22_SshKeyData
classes.description: Data class for SSH keys in F22 version, handling username and key attributes.

classes.name: F38_SshKeyData
classes.description: Derived class for SSH key data in F38, with modified string representation to escape quotes in the key.

classes.name: RHEL9_SshKeyData
classes.description: Placeholder class for RHEL9 SSH key data, inherits from F38_SshKeyData without modifications.

classes.name: F22_SshKey
classes.description: Command class for managing SSH key installation, including parsing arguments and maintaining a list of SSH users.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for SSH key data classes, initializing username and key attributes.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: String representation of SSH key data, including arguments.

methods.name: _getArgsAsStr
methods.description: Generates string of command-line arguments for SSH key data, escaping quotes if necessary.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates and returns an option parser for the sshkey command.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to create an SSH key data object, handling errors and warnings.

methods.name: dataList
methods.description: Returns the list of SSH user data objects.

methods.name: dataClass
methods.description: Property that returns the class used for SSH key data objects.
